in_hindi.name: हरिवंश
in_hindi.long_meaning: हरि (Vishnu) + वंश (lineage) = विष्वक्सेन के वंश (lineage of Vishnu)

in_marathi.name: Harivansh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Harivansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Harivansh means 'messenger of God Hari'. The name Harivansh is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Hari' which means God and 'Vansh' which means messenger or lineage. This name is often given to boys in the Hindu community as a symbol of wisdom, power, and divine connection.
